digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary 'acceptance/success criteria' in reviewer prompts conflates two separate concepts in LLM rubric generation, creating false distinctions in the generated criteria guide.
The term 'Success Criteria' must be renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria' throughout reviewer prompt files and the criteria routing index to eliminate noise in the rubrics.
Regeneration of the criteria guide from updated prompts must be performed after textual substitutions to ensure downstream documentation reflects the consolidated terminology.

The routing index edit rotates the regver criteria-registry stamp, invalidating outstanding plan-review attestations; this is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) merges to grandfather the change.
Deliberately excluded sites (plan_review_T2.md generic trial metrics, dod_uncertifiable definition-of-done wording) must survive the rename to preserve semantic correctness in those contexts.
Registry version rotation and acceptance criteria preservation must be verified by capture-at-runtime test assertions rather than hardcoded literals.
